newsitems.title: It's time for GTA 5's last challenge: 20 more mods aimed at finally breaking it completely
newsitems.contents: It is time to say goodbye to Grand Theft Auto 5. Did we not say goodbye literally yesterday, when I installed a mod named Farewell Los Santos, and there was even a video and everything, and we put Komm Susser Tod over it?.. Read more.

newsitems.title: Take Down the Kortz Center and More High-Value Targets in The Heist Event
newsitems.contents: Get in, get out, and make a killing in this week’s GTA Online Heist Event. Assemble a crew of familiar faces or perfect strangers, gather your gear, execute a robbery, and exfiltrate safely to earn doubled first-time completion bonuses for completing all the Original Heists, The Doomsday Heist, and The Diamond Casino Heist. newsitems.contents: Today, we’re answering the most frequently asked questions on our socials.
